'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip]], [[2025 Gaza City offensive]]
***At least 75 [[Palestinians]] are killed, including 44 who are killed in [[Gaza City]], during [[Israel]]'s military assault. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/9/4/live-hamas-says-ready-for-truce-deal-as-israel-pounds-gaza-city-overnight (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Afghanistan earthquake]]
**Hundreds of deceased people are found under the rubble of collapsed houses after the August 31 [[earthquake]] in [[Nangarhar Province]], [[Afghanistan]], bringing the death toll to 2,205. [https://apnews.com/article/afghanistan-earthquake-deaths-50fe948763c786f36780267a8a7e9afc (AP)]
*Seventeen people are injured and 15 others are hospitalized when a [[double-decker bus]] crashes near [[London Victoria station|Victoria station]] in [[London]], [[England]]. [https://apnews.com/article/london-bus-crash-victoria-station-injuries-275007304c62eff0d57cba27d45ab9d4 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Vaccination policy of the United States]]
**[[Make America Healthy Again]]
***The [[States of the United States|U.S. state]] of [[Florida]] announces it will formally eliminate all [[vaccination policy|vaccination mandates]], including school and childhood mandates for [[chickenpox]], [[measles]], and [[polio]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/us-florida-to-abolish-all-vaccine-mandates/a-73886198 (DW)] [https://apnews.com/article/florida-vaccine-mandates-desantis-schools-health-38688345e8d2cac6ecc6e92f3babe0f8 (AP)]
*The [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] declares a new [[Ebola]] [[Ebola outbreak|outbreak]] in [[Kasaï Province]] with 28 suspected cases and 15 deaths, confirmed as the [[Zaire ebolavirus|Zaire strain]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/congo-declares-new-ebola-outbreak-three-years-after-last-2025-09-04/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Algeria–Mali relations]]
**The [[Mali]]an [[Politics of Mali|transitional government]] files a lawsuit against [[Algeria]] at the [[International Court of Justice]] and accuses Algeria of destroying a [[Malian Armed Forces|Malian military]] [[drone warfare|drone]] near [[Tinzaouaten]], [[Kidal region]], to allegedly hinder Mali's campaign against armed rebels in the [[Mali War]]. [https://apnews.com/article/mali-icj-case-algeria-drone-0cc0b2aaea816d6386affac4e1556733 (AP)]
*[[Belarus–Poland relations]]
**[[Belarus]] detains a [[Polish people|Polish national]] and a [[Belarusians|Belarusian citizen]] on charges of [[espionage]] after [[State Security Committee of the Republic of Belarus|authorities]] allege they possessed documents on [[Zapad 2025]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/polish-national-held-neighbouring-belarus-suspicion-espionage-media-says-2025-09-04/ (Reuters)]
*[[Ecuador–United States relations]], [[War on drugs]]
**The [[United States]] designates [[Ecuador]]ian [[drug cartel]]s [[Los Choneros]] and [[Los Lobos (gang)|Los Lobos]] as [[terrorist organizations]]. [[United States Secretary of State|U.S. secretary of state]] [[Marco Rubio]] also says that the U.S. will support the [[Ecuadorian Navy]] by providing $6 million in drones and $13 million for general security in the fight against these gangs. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/us-designates-ecuador-gangs-terrorist-organizations-2025-09-04/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Chromebook procurement scandal]]
**Former [[Indonesia]]n [[Ministry of Education, Culture, Research, and Technology|education minister]] and [[Gojek]] co-founder [[Nadiem Makarim]] is detained after prosecutors name him as a suspect in a [[Corruption in Indonesia|corruption]] case over the alleged unauthorized procurement of [[Chromebook]] laptops that resulted in state losses estimated at [[Indonesian rupiah|Rp]] 1.98 trillion ([[United States dollar|US$]]121.85 million). [https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/indonesia-detains-former-minister-gojek-founder-suspect-graft-case-2025-09-04/ (Reuters)]
*[[Robodebt scheme]]
**[[Australia]] agrees to pay an additional [[Australian dollar|A$]]475 million (US$309M) in compensation to victims of the unlawful "Robodebt" [[Welfare spending|welfare]] [[debt recovery]] scheme, bringing total repayments and compensation to A$2.4 billion (US$1.6 bn) in what would be the country's largest [[class action]] settlement if approved by [[Judiciary of Australia|the courts]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/australia-agrees-record-309-million-payout-victims-illegal-debt-recovery-scheme-2025-09-04/ (Reuters)]
*[[2025 Hollow Water First Nation stabbings]]
**Two people are killed, including the suspect, and eight others are injured in a [[Spree killer|stabbing spree]] in [[Hollow Water First Nation]], [[Manitoba]], [[Canada]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/manitoba/hollow-water-first-nation-serious-incident-rcmp-1.7624882 (CBC)]
*A [[Hong Kong]] [[Judiciary of Hong Kong|jury]] convicts three people and acquits five others over 2020 bomb plots targeting [[List of hospitals in Hong Kong|hospitals]] and [[MTR|trains]] during the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong|COVID-19 pandemic]], finding them guilty of [[Criminal conspiracy|conspiracy]] to cause explosions but not of [[Terrorism in China|terrorism]] charges under the [[United Nations Security Council Resolution 1373|UN anti-terrorism law]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/hong-kong-jury-convicts-three-acquits-five-anti-terrorism-trial-2025-09-04/ (Reuters)]
*Former [[Prime Minister of Thailand|Thai prime minister]] [[Thaksin Shinawatra]] leaves [[Thailand]] after a [[Judiciary of Thailand|court]] ruling that placed him at risk for arrest. [[Royal Thai Police|Police]] indicate that he was allowed to leave the country as there is no active [[arrest warrant|warrant for his arrest]]. [https://apnews.com/article/thaksin-shinawatra-hospital-constitutional-court-politics-e65bf7a070c1e6548a6a4415d35703d5 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Jamaican general election]]
**[[Jamaica]]'s [[Jamaica Labour Party|Labour Party]] wins the general election with 34 seats in the [[Parliament of Jamaica|House of Representatives]] against 29 for the [[People's National Party]], securing a third term for [[Prime Minister of Jamaica|Prime Minister]] [[Andrew Holness]] amid a voter turnout of 39.5%. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/jamaicas-labour-party-wins-third-term-promising-tax-cuts-2025-09-04/ (Reuters)]
*[[Censorship in Nepal]]
**[[Nepal]] orders [[Nepal Telecommunications Authority|its telecommunications authority]] to [[internet censorship|block access]] to unregistered social media platforms after companies failed to meet government requirements to register locally and designate [[Regulatory affairs|compliance representatives]]. [https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/society-equity/nepal-block-some-social-media-including-facebook-2025-09-04/ (Reuters)]
*[[Argentina]]'s [[Argentine National Congress|Congress]] overturns [[President of Argentina|President]] [[Javier Milei]]'s [[veto]] of a [[Law of Argentina|bill]] expanding spending and protections for people with [[Disability in Argentina|disabilities]], marking the first such reversal of [[Presidency of Javier Milei|his presidency]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/argentina-lawmakers-overturn-milei-veto-raising-stakes-before-elections-2025-09-04/ (Reuters)]
